szoveg_eredeti:
You can have Perplexity Teammates run your marketing studio that does end to end video creation for your product

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-11T16:08:36+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2120549261955956873; média: videó, 50 másodperc]
This commercial studio turns a few product photos and a one-line goal into a finished video ad.

My Product Builder teammate created this app that researches a brand, writes a brief, pitches three directions with their own hooks, generates voiceover lines and sound design, and draws a six-shot storyboard for each.

Stills are lower-cost vs. video, so you approve the whole commercial as a storyboard, and only the chosen direction gets rendered as final video.

Computer sends the frames and the product photos to Seedance 2.5 with a time-coded shot list and sound notes, and outputs a 1080p vertical ad with native audio.
